props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: the science of the non-artefactual world
props.positive_test: the work's claim is about nature, number or computation as such
props.negative_test: a claim about an engineered artefact's performance (branch 2) or about a patient population (branch 3)
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed.

props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: the design and operation of artefacts
props.positive_test: the work advances how a built system is designed, controlled or manufactured
props.negative_test: the artefact is the learning algorithm itself -> Method axis, not here
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Robotics lives here (2.2), not as a top branch.

props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: human health as the object of knowledge
props.positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about human health, disease, care or populations
props.negative_test: non-human biology -> 1.6; device engineering with no clinical claim -> 2.6
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Largest branch in this corpus; that asymmetry is a finding, never engineered away. Top surfaces: Healthcare, Healthcare AI, Medical Research, Artificial Intelligence in Medicine.

props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: managed biological production systems
props.positive_test: the knowledge advanced concerns crops, livestock, forests, fisheries or animal health
props.negative_test: wild-organism biology -> 1.6 ecology/zoology; food retail -> Sector axis
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Near-empty here; kept because it is OECD's and because agri-ML is large outside this institute.

props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: human behaviour, institutions and their study
props.positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about people, groups, markets, institutions or learning
props.negative_test: a demand made on an AI system (fairness, accountability) -> Desired properties axis
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed.

props.characteristic: OECD FOS field: interpretation of human culture and thought
props.positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about language, art, history, or philosophical argument
props.negative_test: language as a signal the model consumes -> Modality axis; NLP as machinery -> Method axis
props.notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Nearly empty in this corpus; reported, not balanced.

props.positive_test: the surface is on-axis but names no field at any granularity
props.negative_test: a name that says nothing about discipline at all is ABSENT from this axis, not uninformative (AXES.md 8b)
props.notes: Required by AXES.md 8b. Excluded from this axis's shares. Legitimately near-empty here, for the same reason as the properties axis (D-P4/D-P5): vague-but-on-axis surfaces are absorbed as branch-level surfaces on the field nodes.

props.positive_test: the paper's contribution is a mathematical or statistical result stated for its own field
props.negative_test: optimisation, game theory, information theory and learning theory supply machinery to ML and are Method (AXES.md 7)
props.notes: Thin by construction: this axis exports most maths-shaped names to Method.

props.positive_test: the served field is a computing discipline that predates and survives machine learning
props.negative_test: core AI/ML/DL machinery is NOT here: it is Method, Modality or Task. See RATIONALE D1.
props.notes: OECD's own scope note places AI and bioinformatics inside 1.2; we deviate on both. Declared defect.
